title: L^p monotonicity identity with the annular conical term (Simon Ch. 4, 4.1-4.9, kappa = (p-n)/(4p)) for the contract varifold
statement: Let n >= 1 and l >= 0 be natural numbers and p a real number with p > n. Let U be an open subset of R^(n+l), V a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure RectifiableVarifold n l U) with weight mu := V.weight and p_x := V.tangentProj x, and H : R^(n+l) -> R^(n+l) such that V has generalized mean curvature H in U (V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H). Let y in R^(n+l) and let R, Lambda be real numbers with R > 0 and closed ball B_R(y) contained in U. Assume (T1) for mu-a.e. x: if x lies in the open ball B°_R(y), then p_x = P.starProjection for some n-dimensional subspace P; (T2) x -> p_x is a.e.-strongly measurable with respect to mu restricted to B°_R(y); 0 < Lambda <= 1; and V.scaledLpNorm H p y R <= ofReal(kappa Lambda) with kappa := (p - n)/(4p), i.e. (R^(p-n) * integral^-_{B_R(y)} |H|^p dmu)^(1/p) <= kappa Lambda in [0, infinity]. Write omega_n := unitBallVolume n, alpha' := 1 - n/p (real exponent), balls closed, and for F : R -> R put Phi(r) := F(r) * (r^n)^(-1) * mu(B_r(y)).toReal + F(r) - 1. Then there exists F : R -> R such that: (i) for every r in (0, R): e^(-Lambda) <= F(r) <= e^Lambda and |F(r) - 1| <= Lambda (r/R)^(alpha'); (ii) for all s, r with 0 < s <= r < R: Phi(s) <= Phi(r), and the lower (extended) integral over B_r(y) minus B_s(y) of ofReal(|x - y - p_x(x - y)|^2 / |x - y|^(n+2)) with respect to mu is at most ofReal(e^Lambda (Phi(r) - Phi(s))); (iii) there is a real t >= 0 with V.HasDensity y t (i.e. mu(B_r(y))/ofReal(omega_n r^n) -> ofReal t as r -> 0+) and omega_n t <= Phi(r) for every r in (0, R).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ), V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → ∀ (y : Amb n ℓ) (R Λ : ℝ), 0 < R → closedBall y R ⊆ U → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ ball y R → ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n ∧ V.tangentProj x = P.starProjection) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => V.tangentProj x) (V.weight.restrict (ball y R)) → 0 < Λ → Λ ≤ 1 → V.scaledLpNorm H p y R ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((p - n) / (4 * p) * Λ) → ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, Real.exp (-Λ) ≤ F r ∧ F r ≤ Real.exp Λ ∧ |F r - 1| ≤ Λ * (r / R) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ) / p)) ∧ (∀ s r : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r → r < R → F s * (s ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y s)).toReal + F s - 1 ≤ F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1 ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall y r \ closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - y - V.tangentProj x (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂V.weight ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp Λ * ((F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1) - (F s * (s ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y s)).toReal + F s - 1)))) ∧ ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ V.HasDensity y t ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, unitBallVolume n * t ≤ F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1
